SUMMARY: 2 to 3 plain, professional sentences (max 45 words) based ONLY on the title and snippet. Do not invent facts, numbers, quotes or names. If the snippet is thin, summarise cautiously. 3. Escape &, < and > inside TITLE and SUMMARY as HTML entities. 4. For the LAST article, change "border-bottom:1px solid #d3e3f5;" to "border-bottom:none;". 5. Output ONLY the … rows. No introduction, no markdown, no code fences, no wrapper, no commentary.
